propositions: Close must run plan review before completion verification when enforce flag is enabled, checking signature, registry currency, material drift, phase compatibility, and configured pin health.
CLOSE validity profile must accept code-drift-free reviews while excluding code freshness checks, since implementation changes are expected during execution.
Pre-status-check callback must execute inside the existing transaction lock after fresh state read and structural checks but before STATUS append, catching plan/signature/phase/material/pin changes.
Unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, own-material drift, malformed metadata, and phase incompatibility must always block close; pin drift/missing/malformed blocks only when pin enforcement is enabled.
Close must perform zero model/network calls and fail closed as unavailable on any unexpected local read/parse/signature exception.
Default-off behavior and existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed, force-close bypass) must preserve byte-for-byte equivalence with current close paths.
